svg.title: EH3D-DRILLPRO architecture
svg.desc: EH3D-DRILLPRO reads Excellon drill files, the tool table and the machine file, orders the holes and runs the job through its classic or modern text-mode screens. The job goes to a simulator, to the serial port or a USB adapter, to the EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD node or to EH3D-SERVER. EH3D-ROUTEPRO reuses its protocol, screens and languages. Everything is tested on a computer; on one real machine only the reference run and the moves of each axis have been tried.
